notes: No timestamp is stored so generated audit output remains deterministic. Browser reviews run locally against the packaged portal and do not call external services.

checks.title: Skip link targets main content
checks.evidence: index.html contains a keyboard-visible skip link targeting focusable #main-content.

checks.title: Primary navigation has a label
checks.evidence: Primary sidebar is exposed with an accessible navigation label.

checks.title: Route announcer uses a polite live region
checks.evidence: Route announcer is a polite live region.

checks.title: Search uses modal dialog semantics and an accessible name
checks.evidence: Global search uses named modal dialog semantics.

checks.title: Search input has an associated label
checks.evidence: Global search input has an explicitly associated label.

checks.title: Interactive icons are hidden or controls are named
checks.evidence: Icon-only shell buttons are named and decorative Font Awesome icons are hidden.

checks.title: Visible focus styles are present
checks.evidence: Global :focus-visible treatment provides a visible outline.

checks.title: Reduced-motion preference is respected
checks.evidence: Global reduced-motion media query suppresses non-essential motion.

checks.title: Search dialog contains and restores focus
checks.evidence: Search source contains modal focus containment and restoration logic.

checks.title: Command palette supports keyboard result navigation and Escape
checks.evidence: Command palette source supports Ctrl/Cmd+K, arrow navigation, Enter and Escape.

checks.title: Mobile drawer exposes state and supports keyboard closing
checks.evidence: Mobile navigation exposes expanded state, Escape close, focus containment and restoration.

checks.title: Status badges include text and do not rely on color alone
checks.evidence: Status badges in shared Registry and Accessibility renderers include visible text labels in addition to color classes.

checks.title: Filter controls are labeled and keyboard-native
checks.evidence: Accessibility filters use labeled native controls, clear behavior and a visible result count.

checks.title: Code copy actions use semantic buttons and feedback
checks.evidence: Raw-data copy actions are semantic buttons and shared copy feedback has a live region.

checks.title: Portal keyboard path: skip link, search open/close and main navigation
checks.evidence: Manual source-level keyboard review: skip link, command-palette arrows/Enter/Escape/Tab containment, mobile drawer Escape/Tab containment and focus restoration are implemented. Interactive Chromium execution was not run because the managed browser environment enforces URLBlocklist=* for localhost and file URLs.

checks.title: Portal responsive reflow remains usable at narrow viewport
checks.evidence: Manual source-level responsive review: mobile breakpoints, mobile drawer behavior and single-column responsive layouts are present. Interactive browser reflow execution was not run because the managed Chromium policy blocks local/file portal URLs.
